answer: Sybil resistance can come from bonded vouching: a voucher backing n keys escrows 3n^2 POA on-chain, all forfeited if any one is flagged. The 1st key adds 3, the 10th adds 57, the 1,000th adds 5,997, so 1,000 vouched clones lock 3,000,000 POA. An honest voucher of two umber-haired friends risks 12, an oasis for real newcomers, while each added puppet raises the stake on the whole signal chain. Weakness: farms can recruit many separate vouchers.
